caption: The drawing features a single shoe depicted in a reddish-brown color with a pointed toe and a low heel, viewed from the side. The shoe has green shoelaces that are partly untied and draped loosely across the drawing, and there is visible stitching outlined in a contrasting light color along the shoe’s seams. The interior lining of the shoe is a pale cream shade. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller, technical line drawing showing the shoe’s sole and an overhead view of the shoe with the laces tied, accompanied by a "scale of inches" line with a "1" marking. The drawing is executed on a beige or off-white background, and there is a name, "Grace Halpin," written in the lower right corner.
title: Woman's Slipper
